items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: But what I want to tell you, for a fleeting moment we all were part of the Gramercy Five. Joe, Benjamin, Charlie Smith, Billy Taylor and myself. We worked for Artie Shaw.

ctx.x: Well, Artie -- as you know Artie was a marvelous instrumentalist, you know, and he was a perfectionist also. So -- but he loved the group because we had a dynamite group, you know, with Billy and Charlie Smith, I think was one of the great drummers. He's dead now, he died quite young. But he was a great small band drummer, and a big band drummer. He could just -- he reminded me of Shadow Wilson in that respect, that he could play with a big band and really drive a big band or play with a small group and play…
You played with the Gramercy Five for two years?
